transactionReadOnlyNote: RESOLVED 2026-08-07 (Train 5C2, capability-probe closure). The value was originally recorded UNCONFIRMED because the operator did not retain it from the probe output; it was neither inferred to be 'on' nor asserted to be false. The operator has now supplied it: transaction_read_only = on. The earlier UNCONFIRMED is left described rather than erased, because deleting it would delete the evidence that the gate refused an unretained value rather than guessing at it.

setLocalRole.reason: can_set_role = false refutes the branch by catalogue. Attempting an operation the grant forbids would teach nothing the catalogue has not already said.

verdict.basis: MEMBER=false, USAGE=false, SET=false — no membership in any grade. PostgreSQL 16 split membership into three independent privileges; all three are absent, so there is no reading under which the SET ROLE path exists.
verdict.notRequiresRehearsal: The catalogue answered. This is refutation, not an unknown.
